lanes.summary: The implementation correctly wires the release gate into the publish path, updating `models_t1.sh` and R7 to judge the CRUX smoke on the release binary alongside the admitted nightly, without falling back to the full ladder. `candidate_watch.sh` correctly executes the same gate, and `prepare_bump.sh` properly requires an admissible nightly on all required hosts. Nightly paths are accurately resolved relative to the verdict's directory and prevented from escaping, and `gather_nightly.sh` precisely copies only what the verdict names. All case tables run successfully, mutating tests are properly killed, and no claims were refuted.

Reviewed diff for ticket GH-4117 (0.70 release gate: wire --scope release into autopilot models step, R7, and candidate watch).

1. Ticket Intent and Refutation Review:
- autopilot models step (scripts/release/models_t1.sh) runs `--scope release --nightly <root> --crux <smoke> --cut-commit <sha>` from ladder.release_gate.from on. Verified that smoke on the release binary is produced by the step using crux_sweep_shards.sh under choom -n 1000 with the committed certification.
- R7 preflight rule (scripts/check_publish_preflight.sh rule_r7_release) judges the models step's outputs handed over via PUBLISH_PREFLIGHT_NIGHTLY_ROOT, PUBLISH_PREFLIGHT_CRUX_DIR, and PUBLISH_PREFLIGHT_CUT_COMMIT. When unset, R7 is RED by name and never falls back to the full ladder.
- Candidate watch (scripts/release/candidate_watch.sh) adds the REAL row `models:release-scope`, measures smoke once per candidate SHA, and re-judges against fresh nightlies each run.
- Gate decision logic is unified across all four callers using `scripts/lib/crux_smoke_scope.py applies <contract> <version>`.
- Cop ruling additions (prepare_bump.sh --ship nightly admission, relative nightly paths in certify_nightly.sh / nightly_admission.py, and gather_nightly.sh) are fully implemented and verified.

2. Measured Verification:
- `scripts/check_publish_preflight.sh --selftest`: 60/60 rows pass; 3 mutants killed (falls-back-to-ladder, unwired-ok, undecidable-is-ladder) = 63/63.
- `scripts/check_release_models_t1.sh`: 39/39 rows pass; all 5 mutants killed (models-scope-dropped, models-no-gather, models-never-smoke, models-smoke-no-choom, gather-wholedir).
- `scripts/check_publish_reads_watch.sh`: PASS; mutant r7-handoff-dropped killed.
- `scripts/check_release_shift_left.sh`: PASS; mutants release-gate-skipped and release-smoke-uncached killed.
- `scripts/check_release_bump_pr_body.sh`: 14/15 rows pass; mutants drop-admission and never-release killed (1 expected red row on ladder-ignored is documented pre-from fixture drift #4128).
- `python3 scripts/lib/nightly_admission_cases.py --mutants`: 19 rows pass, 14/14 mutants killed.
- `scripts/check_certify_nightly.sh`: PASS; mutant absolute-paths killed.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: rc 0.
- `bashrs`: 0 gating findings introduced.

No gate weakening, opposite assertions, unbacked claims, or unauthorized changes found. Verdict: PASS.

- check_release_bump_pr_body.sh: 14/15 pass (release-no-nightly-refuses passes and kills drop-admission and never-release mutants; expected pre-existing ladder-ignored failure on legacy fixture tracked in #4128).

- check_certify_nightly.sh: PASS (verdict-relative passes, absolute-paths mutant killed).
- cargo fmt --all -- --check: Clean.

No gates were weakened, no ticket constraints were violated, and all receipt claims are backed by measured results. Verdict is PASS.
